2707-5733-8267.easyPrerequisites: Cybernetic Specialist doesn't have summoning sickness.
2707-5733-8267.notablePrerequisites: You control a Rogue that does not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
2707-5733-8267.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using a Rogue.
Cast Notorious Throng by paying its prowl cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Cybernetic Specialist by paying {1} and tapping it, causing you to put Notorious Throng on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Move to your next turn, drawing Notorious Throng from the bottom of your library due to River Song during your draw step.
Repeat.

5231-5254-6774.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Myth Unbound

708-2459-4753-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Rograkh.
Choose to have Rograkh return to the command zone from your graveyard.
Myth Unbound and Clever Impersonator trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Cast Rograkh from the command zone by paying {0} due to the cost reductions from Myth Unbound and Clever Impersonator.
Repeat.
708-2459-4753-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

2921-6566--5--195.notablePrerequisites: At least one persist creature has a +1/+1 counter on it.
2921-6566--5--195.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the persist creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, its persist ability and Yuna trigger.
Resolve Yuna's ability, putting at least two +1/+1 counters onto the surviving persist creature due to the counter-increasing effect.
If that creature had a -1/-1 counter on it, remove that and one of the +1/+1 counters from it as a state-based action.
Resolve the persist ability from step 2, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1247-5963-7908.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two Halflings.
1247-5963-7908.description:
Activate Marvin using The Notary Hobbits's ability by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}.
Activate Marvin using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-2665-5241.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-2665-5241.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Sakashima's Student and Progenitor Mimic each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Sakashima's Student trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Progenitor Mimic trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-2665-5241.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

413-877-3081-3817.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Morophon.
When Morophon dies, Orah triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
When Sister Hospitaller dies, Orah triggers, allowing you to return a Cleric with mana value 5 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 5.
Resolve the Sister Hospitaller trigger from step 3, returning Morophon from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 7 life.
When Morophon enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Morophon trigger, causing you to gain 1 life for each card in your graveyard.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

224-225-2157-6973.description:
Cast Mutable Explorer by paying {2}{G}.
When Mutable Explorer enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a tapped Mutavault land token.
When the Mutavault token enters the battlefield, Stone-Seeder Hierophant and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Reoslve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Romana II.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping the Mutavault token.
Activate the Mutavault token by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Romana II by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a tapped copy of the Mutavault token.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5256-6972-7232.easyPrerequisites: There are at least two tapped lands on the battlefield.
5256-6972-7232.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Ignition Team.
When Ignition Team dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

1687-5972-6797.notablePrerequisites:
You control an Aura that is attached to another creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature beyond the creature that has the Aura attached.
1687-5972-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing another creature that has an Aura attached to it.
When the creature dies, Cass triggers, returning an Aura that was attached to the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
When the Aura enters the battlefield, Siona triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

1753-2366-2800-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
1753-2366-2800-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Mirari's Wake triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

57-283-4846-6968.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {2}{R}.
57-283-4846-6968.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {2}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

141-2921-3440.description:
Cast Demonic Gifts by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Demonic Gifts, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Demonic Gifts.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Bartolomé del Presidio abilities from step 5.

328-2173-5147-5220.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 6 if Gray Merchant is on the top of your library, or you have {3}{B}{B} available otherwise.
328-2173-5147-5220.description:
Cast Gray Merchant either from your hand by paying {3}{B}{B} or from the top of your library by paying 5 life.
When Gray Merchant enters, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to your devotion to black and causing you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Gray Merchant.
When Gray Merchant dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Gray Merchant from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

1286-2438-5972.notablePrerequisites:
You control an Aura that is attached to another creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature beyond the creature that has the Aura attached.
1286-2438-5972.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another creature that has an Aura attached to it.
When the creature dies, Cass triggers, returning an Aura that was attached to the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
When the Aura enters the battlefield, Ajani's Chosen triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

914-1363-1636.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature,
Opponents control at least two artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-1363-1636.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying its mana cost.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Dockside Extortionist trigger, creating at least two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{R}.
Activate Tradewind Rider by tapping it, Dockside Extortionist and one other creature you control, returning Dockside Extortionist from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
914-1363-1636.notes: If you control creature(s) that can tap to produce mana, you can use that mana to pay for the creature and instead gain mana from the creature's ETB ability.

1-1786-5437-6282.notablePrerequisites:
You have a card in hand.
Your life total is at least 2.
1-1786-5437-6282.description:
Activate Prognostic Sphinx by discarding a card.
Containment Construct triggers, exiling the discarded card with the ability to play it until end of turn.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Queza triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and an opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Prognostic Sphinx ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Valentin, Dean of the Vein // Lisette, Dean of the Root

3025-3097-3490-4659.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Bastion of Remembrance triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Lisette triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers for each counter placed this way.
Resolve the first trigger, choosing to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve all other triggers, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.

372-864-3306.notablePrerequisites:
You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Slip On the Ring exiled by Abdel Adrian.
Eternal Witness exiled by Abdel Adrian.
You have enough mana to cast Slip On the Ring.
372-864-3306.description:
Cast Slip On the Ring by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Eternal Witness and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Eternal Witness trigger.
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Slip On the Ring from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Slip On the Ring.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Eternal Witness and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

803-1494-5974.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Numa triggers, causing you to pay {10} to put five +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2034-2440-3705-5115.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Goblins.
2034-2440-3705-5115.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Squee, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Squee enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Goblin you control.
Activate Gemstone Array's first ability twice by paying {4}, putting two charge counters on it.
Activate Gemstone Array's second ability twice by removing two charge counters from it, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.
If you control four or more Goblins, this combo nets infinite mana.

2034-2173-3558-5220.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Crookshank Kobolds
When Crookshank Kobolds dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Crookshank Kobolds from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Crookshank Kobolds from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

1525-2031-2406-2660-3680.notablePrerequisites:
Stunt Double is a copy of Stormchaser Drake.
Wheel of Sun and Moon attached to you.
1525-2031-2406-2660-3680.description:
Cast Lightning Storm by paying {1}{R}{R}, targeting either copy of Stormchaser Drake.
Stormchaser Drake triggers, which due to Abundance causes you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card and put it into your hand.
Activate Lightning Storm by discarding a land card, putting that land card on the bottom of your library due to Wheel of Sun and Moon.
Resolve the Lightning Storm ability, putting two charge counters on it and changing the target to the other copy of Stormchaser Drake.
Repeat from step 2.
Once Lightning Storm has an arbitrarily large number of charge counters, activate it by discarding a land to change its target to any other target of your choosing to deal infinite damage to that target.
1525-2031-2406-2660-3680.notes: Other players may also activate Lightning Storm to change its target, making this combo risky if you do not have additional land cards in hand to activate Lightning Storm again.

1657-3139.description:
Cast Murderous Redcap by paying {2}{B/R}{B/R}.
When Murderous Redcap enters the battlefield, it and The Great Henge trigger.
Resolve the The Great Henge trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Murderous Redcap and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Murderous Redcap trigger, dealing an amount of damage to itself equal to its power.
Murderous Redcap dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Murderous Redcap's persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.

67-2034-2517-5276.notablePrerequisites: Parallax Wave has at least one fade counter on it.
67-2034-2517-5276.description:
Cast Leonin Relic-Warder by paying {W}{W}.
Leonin Relic-Warder enters the battlefield, triggering its first ability, targeting Parallax Wave.
Holding priority, activate Parallax Wave by removing a fade counter from it, exiling Reveillark.
Resolve the Leonin Relic-Warder trigger, exiling Parallax Wave.
Parallax Wave leaves the battlefield, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Leonin Relic-Warder, adding {C}{C}.
Leonin Relic-Warder leaves the battlefield, triggering its second ability, returning Parallax Wave from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Parallax Wave trigger from step 5, returning Reveillark from exile to the battlefield.
Reveillark enters the battlefield, returning Leonin Relic-Warder from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

598-2452-2523-4089.notablePrerequisites: Liliana has at least three loyalty counters on it.
598-2452-2523-4089.description:
Activate Liliana's third ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, allowing you to cast Zombie spells from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Glasspool Mimic by paying {2}{U}, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Ratadrabik.
Put the original Ratadrabik into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Each other copy of Ratadrabik triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Ratadrabik that is a 2/2 Zombie in addition to its other types.
Cast Ratadrabik from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Repeat from step 3.

1339-1689-2292.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1339-1689-2292.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the Insect token, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

776-1329-1482-2709.notablePrerequisites: Emry and Orcish Mechanics do not have summoning sickness.
776-1329-1482-2709.description:
Tap Orcish Mechanics, sacrificing Jeweled Lotus to deal 2 damage to any target.
Tap Emry, targeting Jeweled Lotus.
Cast Jeweled Lotus.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, allowing you to loot.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

2265-3921-4929-5189.notablePrerequisites: Cryptic Trilobite has at least three +1/+1 counters.
2265-3921-4929-5189.description:
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from Cryptic Trilobite, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Ghave's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing the Saproling token, putting three +1/+1 counters on Cryptic Trilobite.
Repeat.
